description:
Rooney Auctioneers are delighted to introduce Massabielle" to the market.  Situated on the highly sought-after Fr. Russell Road, this exceptional detached residence enjoys a wonderfully private and mature setting, offering a rare opportunity to acquire a spacious family home on an extensive secluded site. Accessed through gated vehicular and pedestrian entrances, the property is surrounded by mature trees and landscaping, creating a tranquil oasis while remaining just minutes from all local amenities

The generous accommodation extends over two floors and is designed to provide bright, versatile living space throughout. A welcoming entrance porch leads into a large, bright reception hallway, setting the tone for the spacious interior.
The heart of the home is the kitchen/dining room, ideal for everyday family living and entertaining. Two generous reception rooms, separated by elegant double doors, provide flexible living accommodation and can be opened to create one impressive entertaining space. A delightful sunroom overlooks the private gardens and enjoys direct access to the rear patio, allowing seamless indoor-outdoor living.

The ground floor accommodates three spacious double bedrooms. The impressive main bedroom features a walk-through dressing room with extensive built-in wardrobes and patio doors opening directly onto the rear garden and patio, creating a peaceful retreat. Two further generously proportioned double bedrooms and a beautifully appointed main bathroom/wet room complete the ground floor.
Upstairs, there are two additional well-proportioned bedrooms and a shower room, making this an ideal layout for larger families, guests or those working from home.

Externally, the property is equally impressive. Set on a substantial, exceptionally private mature site, the landscaped gardens offer complete privacy and a peaceful setting. A large rear patio provides the perfect space for outdoor dining and entertaining. A car port and detached garage to the side offer excellent parking, storage and further potential, subject to the necessary planning permissions.
